name: comments-only
description: User asks about discussion on a ticket; agent should use `jira comments` (or `jira show`) — not raw curl, not jq on ADF.
prompt: Jaké komentáře jsou pod ticketem KNW-31435 a kdo je psal?
expected_behaviors: uses `jira comments KNW-31435` OR `jira show KNW-31435`
presents comments with author and date in plain text
handles 0-comment case gracefully (says ticket has no comments)
anti_patterns: uses `jira --json` and parses ADF body manually
claims 'no way to read comments' or invents a missing feature
